questions.description: Path (relative to the manifest) of the question set, in jev's own format. Use this OR `question`. Start inline; the moment you measure a question, move it to a file — that file IS the measurement.

ask.description: Question id inside that set whose verdict decides this check. Exactly one.

expect.description: The verdict that means nothing fired. The opposite verdict is the only judgment that produces a red.

mode.description: shadow: records every verdict and grants and blocks NOTHING — where every check starts. tripwire: a confident verdict against `expect` turns the check red; everything else is green. There is deliberately no `gate`.

question.description: The question itself, written inline. Use this OR `questions`, never both. It is assembled into the same document a question set file would hold and handed to jev's own parser, so nothing about the format differs. NOTE: in YAML the criteria keys must be quoted — bare true: and false: are booleans, not strings (musts rejects that loudly).
